claims.claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows by defining deterministic route-policy dispatch, GraphRAG context-pack grounding, and runtime gate controls.
Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting workflow value realization with usage-based forecasting and reusable commercialization patterns.
Built audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows by pairing evaluation gates with telemetry and rollback controls.
Standardized production-readiness gates across the AI solution lifecycle, using managed workflow orchestration, replayable runtime design, and governed exit dispositions to accelerate adoption.
Architected high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data flows, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a scalable operating model.
